name: fieldops-copilot
description: Private AI assistant for service businesses — RAG over internal documents, live CRM lookups, and real-time call assistance.
author: Ilhan Akbudak

scripts.dev:api: cd services/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.api:lint: cd services/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.api:typecheck: cd services/api && uv run mypy app
